key_insight: Cooperative quoter and risk-manager agents achieve the strongest reported market-making result only with careful reward shaping, not decomposition alone.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports liquidity-provision research for thin prediction-market order books by combining reconstructed order data with inventory-aware reinforcement learning.
method: Reconstruct order-level LOBSTER-format data from Polymarket L2 feeds.
Redesign market-maker observations, actions and inventory controls in JaxMARL-HFT.
Train recurrent IPPO quoter and risk-manager agents with reward blending and post-fill markout.
evidence_signal: Training used 417 real markets, with evaluation based on realised end-of-episode portfolio value on held-out markets; no configuration established positive average portfolio value.
watch_item: Each configuration used one training seed, and jointly changed observations, actions and risk constraints prevent isolating their individual contributions.
paper_title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Market Making on Prediction-Market Order Books
